mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 1500 units signals increased consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between HOUST and consumer confidence indices
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 40% of instances when HOUST > 1500, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) signals accommodative monetary policy, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in low-rate periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in payroll employment (PAYEMS) and decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strong labor market, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical labor market indicators and SPX correlation
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 30% of instances when both triggers are met, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 95 signals decreased supply chain pressure, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 50% of instances when INDPRO < 95, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.
